notes.title: eden for MacOS and Linux
notes.notes:
Greetings non-windows users,

Experimental Builds for MacOS and Linux are now available!
If you have trouble running them, please create a Discussion in the Bug Reports section here: http://steamcommunity.com/app/323620/discussions/2/

Take care!
- thatsmauri
